preamble: Dilated Cardiomyopathy  |  100-Point Adverse Prognostic Score  |  ACC/AHA 2022 Heart Failure Guidelines / ESC 2021 Heart Failure Guidelines / HFSA 2022  |  Progression Trajectory: Fast / Moderate / Slow

questions.question: Is LVEF ≤35% on echo or cardiac MRI (severe systolic dysfunction)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — LVEF ≤35% confirmed; threshold for ICD implantation (Class I, ≥3 months GDMT); highest heart failure mortality risk subgroup

questions.question: Is LV end-diastolic diameter >65 mm (men) / >60 mm (women), or Z-score >3 in pediatric patients?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — severe LV dilation confirmed; associated with higher wall stress, functional MR, and adverse remodeling despite GDMT

questions.question: Is there moderate-to-severe functional MR (vena contracta ≥4 mm or regurgitant fraction >30%) from annular dilation?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — significant FMR confirmed; amplifies volume overload; worsens LA dilation and AF risk; MitraClip or surgical repair may be considered

questions.question: Is there mid-wall septal late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) on CMR indicating myocardial fibrosis?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — mid-wall LGE present; independent predictor of SCD, VT, and adverse outcomes in DCM; supports ICD implantation even with LVEF 36–45%

questions.question: Does LGE involve ≥3 myocardial segments or >10% of LV mass on CMR?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — extensive fibrosis burden; strongly associated with VT storm, SCD, and non-response to GDMT

questions.question: Is there a confirmed pathogenic variant in LMNA (lamin A/C) on genetic testing?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — LMNA cardiomyopathy confirmed; highest SCD/VT risk among all DCM genotypes; ICD recommended when ≥2 risk factors present (NSVT, LVEF <45%, male sex, non-missense mutation)

questions.question: Is there documented NSVT (≥3 beats, ≥120 bpm) or sustained VT on Holter or event monitor?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — ventricular arrhythmia confirmed; major ICD indication in LVEF ≤35%; LMNA + NSVT combination carries especially high SCD risk

questions.question: Is there LBBB (QRS ≥150 ms) or high-degree AV block (≥2nd degree) on ECG?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — LBBB ≥150 ms is the strongest CRT predictor; AV block in DCM suggests LMNA etiology; both indicate dyssynchrony and accelerated progression

questions.question: Is NT-proBNP >3000 pg/mL (or BNP >400 pg/mL) despite ≥3 months of optimized GDMT?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — persistently elevated natriuretic peptide on GDMT; indicates refractory wall stress; associated with higher HF hospitalization and mortality; consider LVAD evaluation

questions.question: Is high-sensitivity troponin persistently elevated (above ULN on ≥2 measurements ≥2 weeks apart)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — ongoing myocyte injury confirmed; suggests active inflammatory or infiltrative process; prompts CMR for myocarditis/sarcoidosis pattern; worse prognosis

questions.question: Is there a pathogenic variant in TTN (truncating), SCN5A, RBM20, or PLN in addition to LMNA?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — high-risk DCM genotype confirmed; TTN truncating variants in ~20% of familial DCM; RBM20 and PLN associated with aggressive early-onset phenotype and high arrhythmia burden

questions.question: Is there Duchenne/Becker muscular dystrophy, Barth syndrome, or Emery-Dreifuss MD as the underlying etiology?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — syndromic DCM confirmed; Duchenne DCM near-universal by age 18; Barth syndrome carries infant mortality risk; specialized multidisciplinary management required

questions.question: Is the patient NYHA Class III or IV despite ≥3 months of optimized GDMT (ACEi/ARNi + beta-blocker + MRA + SGLT2i)?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — refractory heart failure symptoms on maximally tolerated GDMT; CRT-D, LVAD, or transplant evaluation indicated

questions.question: Has the patient had ≥1 heart failure hospitalization in the past 12 months?
questions.confirmingAnswer: Yes — prior HF hospitalization is the single strongest predictor of subsequent HF death; triggers advanced therapy referral pathway
